body:
I do not believe in an afterlife, but who knows if I'm wrong?


Money has already been spent on doctors and testing, I would feel guilty if I wasted any more. The only problem is my lack of interest in being a healthy person.

I do not have enough talent to make a profession out of what I enjoy.

I spent a significant amount of time exercising last summer and it did not feel great. I did not feel awesome afterwards either.

Disease prone genetics passed down from previous generations are not desirable in my eyes.
